Digital Marketing Manager, Tata Consultancy Services — Nov 2024 - Present
Leading campaign planning and execution for enterprise clients; rebuilt multi-channel acquisition funnels that improved lead quality for two global accounts. Implemented GA4 tagging strategy and dashboarding to unify conversion metrics across paid and organic channels. Managed HubSpot marketing automation and lead scoring to increase MQL to SQL velocity. Optimized Google Ads account structures and bidding rules, reducing cost per lead by double-digit percentages on core product lines. Worked closely with content and SEO teams to align on keyword strategy and on-page optimization for priority landing pages. Used Agile ceremonies to coordinate cross-functional sprints and Git for versioning of campaign assets and landing page code.

Performance Marketer, Meesho — Mar 2021 - Oct 2024
Owned performance campaigns for seller acquisition and consumer growth across search and paid social. Built GA4 measurement for funnel attribution and conducted cohort analysis to refine channel mix. Ran HubSpot flows for re-engagement and lifecycle emails, improving retention metrics for targeted cohorts. Scaled Google Ads campaigns with improved keyword segmentation and bidding algorithms to lower CPA while maintaining volume. Supported SEO initiatives by coordinating technical fixes and content briefs aligned to SEM priorities. Participated in Agile squads to deliver weekly optimizations and tracked campaign assets with Git.

Skills: SEO, Google Ads, GA4, HubSpot, SEM, Agile, Git

Education: CA, ICAI
